atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.nazwa: Decrease: work two dc together (dc2tog), work two trebles together (tr2tog)
atlas.szydelko.ujecie.2tog.krok1: For tr2tog, work a treble up to its last step: 2 loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.sc.opis_: Drawing of a double crochet: the hook goes into the stitch, a loop is pulled up, and the yarn is pulled through both loops on the hook.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.hdc.opis: Drawing of a half treble: with one yarn over on the hook, a loop is pulled up and then the yarn goes through all loops at once.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.dc.opis_: Drawing of a treble: with one yarn over, a loop is pulled up, and the loops are worked off two at a time.
atlas.szydelko.oczko_szydelkowe.tr.opis_: Drawing of a double treble: with two yarn overs, a loop is pulled up, and the loops are worked off two at a time.
